title: Duck Totem
description: Replaces the Totem of Undying with a duck. Works on the held item and the full-screen pop animation.
body:
## Duck Totem

Replaces the vanilla **Totem of Undying** texture with a duck — both the held item and the full-screen activation animation.

Based on the `ar_tyyuu` Minecraft skin.

### What it changes
- `assets/minecraft/textures/item/totem_of_undying.png`

### Compatibility
- Minecraft 1.21.1 – 26.1.2
- Works with any loader (client-side texture only)
- Compatible with shader packs
